title: Incomparability for an integral extension
statement:
For an integral map $A\to B$, comparable primes of $B$ with the same
contraction are equal.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: an integral map A -> B supplies Algebra A B and Algebra.IsIntegral A B; the theorem says q < q' implies q.comap (algebraMap A B) < q'.comap (algebraMap A B), whose contrapositive gives equality of comparable primes with the same contraction
